# [Implementation] - Task Plan

## 1. Context

- Smoke section extracted from the archived #306 plan at #364; the body is omitted.

### Manual Smoke Test Protocol

**Mandatory.** Run after `npm run build`, from the worktree root. The blocks run top-to-bottom
exactly as the gate executes them; all state lives in `$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-306` (outside the
workspace, which the CLI requires for state-mutating commands). A failing check exits non-zero, so the
gate attributes the failure to that block.

**S1 — sandbox setup (must run first).**

```bash
set -euo pipefail

REPO="$(pwd)"
BASE="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-306"
rm -rf "$BASE"
mkdir -p "$BASE"
cd "$BASE"
git init -q .
git config user.email smoke@example.com
git config user.name smoke
git checkout -q -b main
printf '# smoke\n' > README.md
git add README.md
git commit -qm init
mkdir -p shim
printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 127\n' > shim/gh
chmod +x shim/gh
export PATH="$BASE/shim:$PATH"
printf '%s\n' "$REPO" > "$BASE/repo-path"
printf 'PASS  S1 sandbox ready at %s (repo %s)\n' "$BASE" "$REPO"
```

**S2 — unit probe: heading RCA accepted, pristine scaffold and cosmetic bullets rejected.**

```bash
BASE="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-306"
REPO="$(cat "$BASE/repo-path")"
cd "$REPO"
npm run build > /dev/null
node - <<'NODE'
const { DiscoveryReport } = require('./dist/domain');
const heading = [
  '# [Discovery] - Login crash',
  '',
  '## Summary & Symptoms',
  '',
  'The login form crashes whenever the session cookie is absent. Reproduced three times in an ephemeral container against the current build with a cleared cookie jar.',
  '',
  '## Root Cause Analysis',
  '',
  'The session resolver returns null and src/login.ts:41 dereferences it without a guard. The call is reached from the form submit handler through the cookie parser.',
  '',
  '## Manual Bug Smoke Test',
  '',
  'The reproduction exits 1 with a stack frame at src/login.ts:41. The same run with a seeded cookie exits 0, three times out of three.',
  '',
  '## Remediation Strategy',
  '',
  'Guard the resolver result before the dereference and add a regression test asserting the form renders an inline validation error.'
].join('\n');
const pristine = require('node:fs').readFileSync('./templates/discovery-plan.md', 'utf8')
  .split('{Title}').join('[Bug] probe')
  .split('{IssueNumber}').join('306')
  .split('{Date}').join('2026-10-27');
const cosmetic = [
  '## 1. Summary & Symptoms', '',
  '## 2. Root Cause Analysis', '',
  '## 3. Manual Bug Smoke Test', '',
  '## 4. Remediation Strategy', '',
  '- **Observed Behavior:** see above',
  '- **Identified Failure Mode:** see above',
  '- **Smoke Test:** see above',
  '- **Remediation:** see above'
].join('\n');

const h = DiscoveryReport.fromMarkdown(heading);
const p = DiscoveryReport.fromMarkdown(pristine);
const c = DiscoveryReport.fromMarkdown(cosmetic);
const fail = [];
if (h.isPopulated !== true) fail.push('heading RCA was rejected');
if (h.filledKeyCount !== 0) fail.push('heading fixture must have zero key bullets');
if (p.isPopulated !== false) fail.push('pristine scaffold was released');
if (p.contentUnitCount !== 0) fail.push('pristine scaffold scored content units');
if (c.isPopulated !== false) fail.push('cosmetic bullets released a content-free skeleton');
if (p.describeMissingEvidence().indexOf('Problem Statement') === -1) fail.push('missing evidence does not name the empty section');
if (fail.length > 0) {
  console.error('FAIL  ' + fail.join('; '));
  process.exit(1);
}
console.log('PASS  S2 heading RCA accepted (filledKeyCount=0), pristine + cosmetic rejected, park names the empty section');
NODE
```

**S3 — end to end: a heading-style report advances DISCOVERY → PLAN.**

```bash
BASE="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-306"
REPO="$(cat "$BASE/repo-path")"
cd "$BASE"
CLI=(node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js")
# `state` prints the RAW value: serialising it would quote strings and make
# `[ "$(state …)" = "PLAN" ]` fail spuriously, which this repo's smoke linter
# rejects by rule.
state() { node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs");const s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8"));const v=eval(process.argv[2]);console.log(v===null||v===undefined?"null":String(v))' ".agyloop/tasks/$1.json" "$2"; }
check() { if eval "$1"; then printf 'PASS  %s\n' "$2"; else printf 'FAIL  %s\n' "$2"; exit 1; fi; }

"${CLI[@]}" transition DISCOVERY --issue 306 --title '[Bug] discovery gate shape' > /dev/null
DIR="$(find artifacts/plans -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | head -1)"
cat > "$DIR"/[[]Discovery[]]*.md <<'EOF'
# [Discovery] - discovery gate shape

**Issue:** #306
**Date:** 2026-10-27
**Author:** AgyLoop Discovery Subagent

## Summary & Symptoms

The discovery gate parks a complete RCA because it only scores the template's key bullets. Reproduced in the sandbox checkpoint with a heading-style report of this exact shape.

## Root Cause Analysis

The predicate counted one markdown construct instead of measuring content, so a heading report scored zero filled keys and the park claimed the report was an unpopulated scaffold.

## Manual Bug Smoke Test

The report above was written into the scaffolded directory and codeloop plan was run against the DISCOVERY checkpoint. The gate must advance to PLAN without any synthetic bullet index.

## Remediation Strategy

Score content from either shape, keep the pristine scaffold rejected, and make the park name the empty sections and blank template keys.
EOF
"${CLI[@]}" plan --issue 306 --title '[Bug] discovery gate shape' > plan-heading.out 2>&1 || true
check '[ "$(state 306 s.currentStage)" = "PLAN" ]' 'S3.1 heading-style report advanced DISCOVERY -> PLAN'
check '! grep -q "Missing evidence" plan-heading.out' 'S3.2 no park was rendered for a populated heading report'
```

**S4 — end to end: a pristine scaffold parks and names the missing evidence.**

```bash
BASE="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-306"
REPO="$(cat "$BASE/repo-path")"
cd "$BASE"
CLI=(node "$REPO/bin/codeloop.js")
# Raw, unquoted values only — see the note in S3 (and the repo smoke linter).
state() { node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs");const s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8"));const v=eval(process.argv[2]);console.log(v===null||v===undefined?"null":String(v))' ".agyloop/tasks/$1.json" "$2"; }
check() { if eval "$1"; then printf 'PASS  %s\n' "$2"; else printf 'FAIL  %s\n' "$2"; exit 1; fi; }

"${CLI[@]}" transition DISCOVERY --issue 307 --title '[Bug] pristine probe' > /dev/null
OUT="$("${CLI[@]}" plan --issue 307 --title '[Bug] pristine probe' 2>&1 || true)"
check 'echo "$OUT" | grep -q "Parked at DISCOVERY for RCA"' 'S4.1 pristine scaffold still parks'
check 'echo "$OUT" | grep -q "Missing evidence"' 'S4.2 park names the missing evidence'
check 'echo "$OUT" | grep -q "content-bearing" || echo "$OUT" | grep -q "content characters"' 'S4.3 park states the measured content'
check 'echo "$OUT" | grep -q "Problem Statement" || echo "$OUT" | grep -q "Observed Behavior"' 'S4.4 park names an empty section or blank key'
check 'echo "$OUT" | grep -q "Checked:"' 'S4.5 park names the checked paths'
check '[ "$(state 307 s.currentStage)" = "DISCOVERY" ]' 'S4.6 the checkpoint did not advance'
```

**S5 — the prompt and the predicate state one contract.**

```bash
BASE="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-306"
REPO="$(cat "$BASE/repo-path")"
cd "$REPO"
node - <<'NODE'
const { formatDiscoveryReportContract } = require('./dist/domain');
const { ResolveSubagentUseCase } = require('./dist/application');
const prompt = new ResolveSubagentUseCase({ get: () => null, getConfig: () => ({}) }).buildDiscoveryTaskPrompt({ issueNumber: 306 });
const contract = formatDiscoveryReportContract();
const fail = [];
if (prompt.indexOf(contract) === -1) fail.push('prompt does not carry the shared contract');
if (contract.indexOf('content-bearing') === -1) fail.push('contract does not name the content measure');
if (prompt.indexOf('- **Key:**') === -1) fail.push('prompt does not name the bullet shape');
if (prompt.indexOf('##') === -1) fail.push('prompt does not name the heading shape');
if (fail.length > 0) {
  console.error('FAIL  ' + fail.join('; '));
  process.exit(1);
}
console.log('PASS  S5 prompt carries the same contract the predicate enforces');
NODE
```

> If the `ResolveSubagentUseCase` constructor shape differs, call
> `buildDiscoveryTaskPrompt` through the same construction the existing `tests/application/resolve-subagent.test.ts`
> uses; the assertion that matters is that the prompt contains `formatDiscoveryReportContract()`.
